scripts.lint: npx solhint "script/**/*.sol" -c .solhint.s.json; npx solhint "src/**/*.sol"; npx solhint "test/**/*.sol" -c .solhint.t.json
scripts.lint-all: npx solhint "script/**/*.sol" -c .solhint.s.json; npx solhint "src/**/*.sol"; npx solhint "test/**/*.sol" -c .solhint.t.json
scripts.echidna: sh -lc 'platform=""; arch="$(uname -m)"; if [ "$arch" = "arm64" ] || [ "$arch" = "aarch64" ]; then platform="--platform linux/amd64"; fi; exec docker run --rm -it $platform -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e FOUNDRY_PROFILE=echidna -v "$PWD":/src -w /src trailofbits/echidna:latest echidna test/fuzzing/Fuzz.sol --contract Fuzz --config echidna-config.yaml'
scripts.echidna-fast: sh -lc 'platform=""; arch="$(uname -m)"; if [ "$arch" = "arm64" ] || [ "$arch" = "aarch64" ]; then platform="--platform linux/amd64"; fi; exec docker run --rm -it $platform -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e FOUNDRY_PROFILE=echidna -v "$PWD":/src -w /src trailofbits/echidna:latest echidna test/fuzzing/Fuzz.sol --contract Fuzz --config echidna-config.yaml --disable-slither --test-limit 10000 --shrink-limit 1000'
scripts.medusa: sh -lc 'platform=""; arch="$(uname -m)"; if [ "$arch" = "arm64" ] || [ "$arch" = "aarch64" ]; then platform="--platform linux/amd64"; fi; exec docker run --rm -it $platform -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/src -v "$HOME/.foundry/bin/forge:/usr/local/bin/forge:ro" -w /src ghcr.io/crytic/medusa:latest /bin/bash -lc "medusa fuzz --config medusa.json"'
scripts.medusa-fast: sh -lc 'platform=""; arch="$(uname -m)"; if [ "$arch" = "arm64" ] || [ "$arch" = "aarch64" ]; then platform="--platform linux/amd64"; fi; exec docker run --rm -it $platform -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/src -v "$HOME/.foundry/bin/forge:/usr/local/bin/forge:ro" -w /src ghcr.io/crytic/medusa:latest /bin/bash -lc "medusa fuzz --config medusa.json --test-limit 1"'
